find the size table in lwplsnen.dll or another DLL
resolution: Not settled: no size table was found in wordpro.exe, wpenc70.dll or lwplsnen.dll (byte and text searches), so the list is probably built at run time from the installed font. Used instead (estimated): sizes 8–72 in common steps, Enlarge/Reduce = 2 pt, range 6–96 pt. Opening the status-bar size popup in the running original would settle it.
